name: @neuropause/desktop
description: NeuroPause Desktop — the AI operating layer (Electron + React + TypeScript).
author: NeuroPause

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.package: node scripts/generate-notices.cjs && node scripts/generate-build-info.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never && npm run verify:release && npm run verify:universal
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/generate-notices.cjs && node scripts/generate-build-info.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/generate-notices.cjs && node scripts/generate-build-info.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never && npm run verify:release && npm run verify:universal && npm run verify:artifact
scripts.package:win: node scripts/generate-notices.cjs && node scripts/generate-build-info.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && npm run verify:release -- --platform win
scripts.package:mac:universal: node scripts/generate-notices.cjs && node scripts/generate-build-info.cjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --universal --publish never && npm run verify:release && npm run verify:universal
